The company receives a tax deduction upon the exercise of non-qualified stock options by employees for the 
difference between the exercise price and the market price of the underlying common stock on the date of exercise. 
The provision for income taxes that is currently payable does not reflect $14.6 million and $10.9 million of such 
benefits of the company that have been allocated to capital in excess of par value in 2011 and 2010, respectively.
